boundaries: GSC remains authoritative for owned Google Search performance and Google's observed index status.
Ahrefs remains authoritative only for its own market, keyword, backlink and competitive datasets.
This repository owns reproducible technical observations, scope metadata, normalized technical evidence and regression comparison only.
Repository-owned HTTP follows validated public-IP pinning on every redirect hop while preserving hostname TLS/SNI.
Third-party SiteOne/Lighthouse/browser fetches run only for explicitly trusted targets and use their native DNS/TLS stack.

SiteOne 2.5.1 forced-IP --resolve is not used for HTTPS because its HTTP fetcher substitutes the URL host with the raw IP while restoring only the Host header, which changes TLS/SNI/certificate semantics and can fail healthy HTTPS targets.

The SiteOne preflight rejects requested origins whose DNS answers include non-public addresses and records the validated origins in reports/siteone-network-preflight.json before a trusted advanced crawl starts.
Nu validates a local safe snapshot and never receives the user target URL as a network input.

Nu tool acquisition resolves the official validator/validator latest vnu.jar at run time, requires exactly one matching asset, requires a GitHub-provided sha256 digest, verifies downloaded bytes against that digest, and records exact release/asset/commit/hash provenance in reports/vnu-tool-metadata.json.
Bounded and sitewide scopes are separate contracts and must never be silently conflated.
Rendered browser evidence and HTTP-response evidence retain separate observation-layer labels.
Evidence manifest schema 1.2 records generic scope_complete/crawl_limit_reached fields; sitewide legacy aliases are retained only for sitewide compatibility.
Every literal reports/* artifact used by the audit is contract-owned and, except for the evidence manifest itself, hashed by the evidence manifest before upload.
Redundant SiteOne text reports are disabled so no uploaded report bypasses artifact provenance.
Sitemap extraction reports not_applicable when no sitemap candidates were advertised, complete when its applicable bounded extraction finished without errors or truncation, and partial otherwise.
A sitewide completeness claim is invalid when the crawl cap is reached or crawl-scope.json says scope_complete=false.
A regression claim requires a compatible successful prior run plus manifest-bound SHA-256 verification of baseline findings and graph artifacts.
New warning/error relationship issues are regressions; new informational relationship observations are not automatically regressions.
External URL selection does not import external source semantics into repository output.
Tool findings are diagnostics; SEO owns interpretation and prioritization.
Client, target and run-specific truth belongs in runtime input or artifacts, not permanently on main.
